description: This file contains functions for computing project task schedules and timelines based on task and project data, including date calculations and recursive project processing.

methods.name: _compute_tasks
methods.description: Calculates task start and end dates based on task dependencies, user assignments, and project timelines.

methods.name: _compute_project
methods.description: Recursively computes task schedules for a project and its subprojects.

methods.name: _project_compute
methods.description: Initializes project data and triggers the recursive project schedule computation.
